text_block_list.text: The summer training camp had flown by in an instant, and it was now the final night.

While devising a strategy for the approaching Kikuka Sho,
I happened to look out the window, and—
choice_data_list: The stars are really clear tonight, huh.

text_block_list.text: Letting my eyes drift across the night sky, a thought crosses my mind.
Oh, I see, tonight is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Ayabe-san!
I'm so sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Not really... I haven't been waiting long.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "I bet you got caught by your classmates or something, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Knowing you, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you saw right through me.
I was just taking care of a quick favor and lost track of time...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's get going!
If we don't hurry, it'll be lights out soon.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Still... was it really okay?
Running side-by-side with me on the final day of the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if they were to measure
the strength I gained from all that training camp work."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If we're looking at it from that angle,
I guess I can measure Ayabe-san too, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And besides... yeah, it's fine! Don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: More importantly, to be honest, I'm just itching to go!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Itching to go?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Ever since the Derby, I've really been training as hard as I could!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That is why right now. Just how close I can get to you,
just how fiercely I can compete against you—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm just itching to find out for myself!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh! W-Wait, Ayabe-san!?
Wh-Why are you laughing!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No... it's just,
you're saying things like a little kid...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
G-Geez! Besides, aren't we
still pretty much just kids in the first place...?!

Bwahahahaha!
I thought I heard some rather delightful conversation over here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Th-This voice...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san and Top Road-san!
Say no more—you both wished to join us as well, didn't you!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: To this march of the Overlord illuminating the night sky!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawawawa... Thanks to Opera O-san, even the midnight rice paddy roads are sparkling bright, yes they are...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Opera O-chan and her partner
are entertaining tonight as always.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Comedy? That works too!!
Come now, Top Road, don't be shy,
join the line.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For the chant during the march,
I want 'HA-O-U!' 'HA-O-U!'
'HA-O-HA-O-HA-O-U!' Please and thank you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"CON-QUER-OR!" "CON-QUER-OR!"
"CON-QUER-CON-QUER-CON-QUER-CON-QUER"...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wahya!? I-I-I made a mistakeee~...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not doing it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to hold back, Ayabe-san!
After all, I reached out to you precisely because I believed 'if it is you, then surely.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I, who banish the very concept of shadows from this world!
An Umamusume worthy of standing beside the Supreme Overlord who illuminates even the new moon night is not so easily—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...What is it, Ayabe-san?

Paying no heed to the bewilderment of TM Opera O and her other friends,
Admire Vega hurriedly glared up at the night sky.

There, countless stars of all sizes
twinkled so brilliantly they seemed to burn themselves
into my retinas—
The moon was nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: On the night of the new moon, I shall come to converse with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Something I've kept doing
ever since I was a little kid who knew nothing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Ever since learning that I had lost you, it has been a habit I have never broken, not even once.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...No way.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (No way, no way, no way, no way, no way—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Did I... forget?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Huh!? A-Ayabe-san!?
Ayabe-saaaan!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-They just left, didn't they...?
Did something happen, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Though she did look like she had gone
a little pale~...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —It's the shadow of the Grim Reaper.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Am I being haunted... No,
or perhaps I'm bringing it upon myself?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uh, wha, umm...?
Is there something weird... stuck to Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then I'll go after her...!
Lights out is coming up anyway,
and it's dangerous for her to be alone...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No, I can't. I must not go.
I must not follow her and step into the darkness."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We shall wait in the light.
—Understood, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san...
...Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh, hah, hah, hah...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (To higher ground... closer to the stars!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I have to... get close to my sister...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......Since when, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (—It's still... burning hot.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (So painful it felt like my throat and chest were burning to cinders.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Is this the same heat I felt during my debut?
...Your heat?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...By the Derby...
I wonder how fast she'll become?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What kind of race... will be next—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......Since when did I...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "And that's why I want to give it my all and compete against everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I want to compete... with everything I have...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Since when did I...
...forget my mission. Forget my sins.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Forgetting even... the very reason I was allowed to live.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...I look forward to working with you today!
It's a showdown!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ………………I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's have a match.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For satisfaction. For selfish desire.
For sheer pleasure. —All for things like that!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: For the sake of someone like "myself"!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Was I... actually alive...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
*gasp*, haa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, I'm... sorry...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...!!
Why—
